pdf.previewIntro: This is a preview version of the upcoming release. Its purpose is to plan for testing and verify that the solution works as expected in your setup before production deployment.
pdf.previewTestingNotice: Several of the changes may affect existing work processes, and there will therefore be a need for targeted testing.
pdf.testingResponsibilityBody:
To ensure a smooth transition to the new version, we ask you to test your setup based on this Release Preview.

This means that you, as a customer, are responsible for testing:

- your own integrations (other third-party systems)
- functionality and configuration used in your daily operations
- critical business processes and end-to-end flows

We test the standard solution in controlled environments.

We recommend that you pay particular attention to verifying functionality that is central to your actual use of the solution, including configuration, customizations and reporting used in your organization.

A more detailed overview of the relevant areas for your setup can be shared and reviewed separately.

Production deployment requires that the relevant testing has been completed on your side.
